sources.title: Navier-Stokes equations on Riemannian manifolds
sources.read_scope: Section 2 diffusion/stress convention and Lemma 3.4 integrated work identity (HTML lines 58-100, 199-212).
sources.used_for: The stress operator is divergence of the symmetrized derivative; distinguish it from Hodge and Bochner Laplacians; integration by parts for total work.
sources.limits: Their S_u is twice Def X; our viscous equation is written as -2 nu div(Def X). Does not establish the entropy inequality or our frame examples.

sources.title: Dynamical zeta functions for geodesic flows and the higher-dimensional Reidemeister torsion for Fuchsian groups
sources.read_scope: Abstract and introduction, especially unit tangent bundle over a hyperbolic orbifold and the Seifert quotient Gamma\PSL(2,R) (HTML lines 14-18, 38).
sources.used_for: Primary source context identifying the geodesic flow as a flow on the Fuchsian quotient Gamma\PSL(2,R).
sources.limits: Not used to prove the frame formulas or compactness of a specific chosen genus-2 quotient.

sources.title: Smooth orbit equivalence rigidity for dissipative geodesic flows
sources.read_scope: Existing local primary source text, Section 2.1 and geodesic bracket discussion; lines 1954-2025, 2097-2111 and 3910-3921 of work/cycle3/entropy_power_sources/sasaki_primary.html.txt.
sources.used_for: The frame (X,H,V) is global orthonormal under the Sasaki metric; [X,H]=pi^*(K_g)V; Liouville volume is invariant under geodesic flow and agrees with Sasaki volume.
sources.limits: The horizontal/vertical bracket identities and our transformed frame are derived directly; this paper is not used to prove the entropy/power equality. Local source receipt is in work/cycle3/entropy_power_sources/manifest.json.

sources.title: Deformations de flots d'Anosov et de groupes fuchsiens
sources.used_for: Prior-art lead: classifies volume-preserving Anosov flows on compact 3-manifolds when weak stable and unstable distributions are smooth.
sources.limits: Full theorem proof and exact equivalence conventions were not audited here.

sources.title: Regular projectively Anosov flows on three-dimensional manifolds
sources.used_for: Prior-art lead that a closed 3D Anosov flow with C2 projectively Anosov splitting is smoothly equivalent to an algebraic Anosov flow; the algebraic models are the PSL(2,R) and Sol types.
sources.limits: This source does not imply the sharp strain/power identity; it does show that the algebraic-flow portion is established prior art.
